speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned weakness and decreased sensation in your right arm; to begin my evaluation, have you noticed these symptoms following any recent injury or trauma?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. He also reports a recent unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds and has a history of diabetes. The patient admits to chronic alcohol use, heavy smoking, and anabolic steroid use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of diabetes, heavy smoking, alcohol use, and anabolic steroid use, I need to clarify if you have any significant shoulder girdle pain or if the weakness is specifically in the biceps, triceps, or forearm muscles. REQUEST TEST: Serum Creatine Kinase (CK), Thyroid-Stimulating Hormone (TSH), and Chest X-Ray.
